exercises.title: Neural Sync: Threat Calculator
exercises.description: Professional threat assessment function with return value.
exercises.targetCode:
# Threat level analyzer
def calculate_threat(enemies, weapons):
    threat_score = enemies * weapons
    return threat_score

level = calculate_threat(10, 3)
print('Threat Level:', level)

exercises.title: Debug Challenge: Missing Return
exercises.description: Function calculates but doesn't return! Add return statement or result is None!
exercises.brokenCode:
def double(x):
    x * 2

result = double(5)
print(result)
exercises.starterCode:
def double(x):
    x * 2

result = double(5)
print(result)
exercises.solution:
def double(x):
    return x * 2

result = double(5)
print(result)

exercises.title: Identity Checker: Access Validator
exercises.description: Create function is_authorized(code) that returns True if code=='007', else False. Test it with '007'.
exercises.solution:
def is_authorized(code):
    return code == '007'

result = is_authorized('007')
print(result)
